authorization_rule: Only QUALIFIED authorizes execution of the already-preregistered OIC-DEFINITION-ONTOLOGY-DISCRIMINATION-002.
claim_ceiling: This work order establishes only bounded availability of the exact NVIDIA provider path under three fixed probes after a recorded remediation signal. It does not establish model quality, institutional semantics, canonical meaning, production readiness, or cross-provider reliability.

decision_rule.DEGRADED: All 3 probes ACCEPTED but one or more elapsed_seconds > 45.0; semantic successor remains unauthorized.
decision_rule.NOT_QUALIFIED: Any provider error, response mismatch, missing probe, or incomplete execution; semantic successor remains unauthorized.
decision_rule.QUALIFIED: All 3 probes ACCEPTED, markers valid, and every elapsed_seconds <= 45.0.

predecessor_failure_evidence.observed_failure_class: authenticated model discovery succeeded, while /v1/chat/completions timed out for target model and returned HTTP 404 'Function ... Not found for account' for an alternative account-visible model

purpose: Recovery qualification of the exact NVIDIA NIM provider path after the account/public-endpoint routing failure recorded by Qualification 001.

remediation_prerequisite.rule: Live qualification 002 is forbidden until the owner records an external NVIDIA remediation/enablement signal in the local remediation marker.
